decisions: The power curve (main's ruling after the first calibration failed): k-h and k-p against the default on roots whose planted blaKPC contig is visible in a share of carriers (synthetic_root.py --visible), so each learner's minimum detectable effect is the smallest share detected on at least 80% of seeds. 3 keyed lineage repeats and each learner's test (stats.LEARNER_TESTS), as H-1 runs

panel_floor.reason: main's ruling on REVIEW-INPUT M1: an H-1 species needs more than 2,000 eligible genomes, so cap-4000 and grr-v1 change the genome set

pool_budget.reason: main's rulings on REVIEW-INPUT4 to REVIEW-INPUT7 (M1, L4): before anything is counted, refuse a comparison whose still-unwritten ksets (the pool and every data root), matrices (10% of a root's ksets), arm outputs (5% of the roots' ksets), the pool's curated/ copy (measured) and WORK-level files (64 MiB) would take more than 80% of the free disk. The per-genome size is the mean of the species' own counted ksets in RAW, else 27.5 MiB (REVIEW-INPUT4's Salmonella estimate). The kset size, the 10%, the 5% and the 64 MiB are stated figures until H-1 measures real per-species ksets and matrices

curate_inputs.reason: the calibration study runs on synthetic roots; they link RAW's species check, and the decision procedure it calibrates doesn't depend on the vocabulary
